name: Chitlati
description: Huatli's aide and attaché who accompanies Saheeli as interpreter.

description_citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
description_citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli asks Saheeli to speak with her voice at the meeting and introduces Chitlati.
timeline.quote: At this meeting, you speak with my voice.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli sails seasick for nearly a week on a Brazen Coalition ship.
timeline.quote: The journey from Queen's Bay across the eastern ocean took nearly a week.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca approaches Saheeli aboard the ship.
timeline.quote: Apex Priestess Caztaca Huicintli, eldest daughter of the late emperor and beloved aunt to the new emperor, waved her hand, dismissing Chitlati and the bowing sailors.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca and Saheeli shake hands and leave for the ship back to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: toward the distant ship that would bear them back to Ixalan
